tasks.title: Improve CI/CD pipeline build time
tasks.description: Current average build time is 18 minutes. Target is under 8 minutes. Investigate Docker layer caching, parallelise test suites, and remove redundant lint steps.

subtasks.title: Enable Docker layer caching in GitHub Actions
Split test suite into parallel jobs

tasks.title: Q3 Product Roadmap Planning
tasks.description: Define and prioritize features for Q3 2026. Align with engineering capacity and business goals. Include OKR mapping.

subtasks.title: Collect feature requests from sales team

tasks.title: Design system component audit
tasks.description: Audit all existing UI components against the new design system guidelines. Flag inconsistencies and create migration tickets.

tasks.title: Define SLOs for core API endpoints
tasks.description: Establish Service Level Objectives for availability (99.9%), latency (p99 < 300ms), and error rate (< 0.1%) for all public-facing endpoints.

tasks.title: Build notification service
tasks.description: Implement event-driven notification service with support for email, in-app, and push channels. Includes retry logic, delivery guarantees, and user preference management.

tasks.title: Refactor authentication middleware
tasks.description: Extract auth logic from route handlers into a dedicated middleware layer. Standardise token validation, refresh flow, and permission checks across all services.

subtasks.title: Audit existing auth logic in route handlers
Migrate all routes to new middleware

tasks.title: Write API documentation
tasks.description: Document all public API endpoints in OpenAPI 3.1 format. Include request/response schemas, authentication examples, and rate limit details.

tasks.title: Fix pagination bug on dashboard table
tasks.description: When navigating to page 3+, the table resets to page 1 on filter change. Reproduce steps in attached video.

tasks.title: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
tasks.description: Implement per-IP and per-token rate limiting using Redis. Limits: 100 req/min for unauthenticated, 1000 req/min for authenticated users.

subtasks.title: Set up Redis rate limit middleware
Add rate limit headers to responses

tasks.title: Export reports as PDF and CSV
tasks.description: Users need to export analytics reports in PDF and CSV formats. PDF should preserve charts; CSV should flatten data rows.

tasks.title: Write onboarding docs for new engineers
tasks.description: Create comprehensive onboarding documentation covering dev environment setup, architecture overview, deployment process, and team norms.

tasks.title: Competitor analysis — June 2026
tasks.description: Analyse top 5 competitors: feature gaps, pricing changes, recent product announcements. Summarise findings for leadership review.

tasks.title: Add full-text search to task list
tasks.description: Implement full-text search across task titles, descriptions, and tags using PostgreSQL tsvector. Include result highlighting and relevance ranking.

tasks.title: Implement webhooks for third-party integrations
tasks.description: Allow customers to register webhook endpoints that receive real-time task events. Support event filtering, retry with exponential backoff, and delivery logs.

tasks.title: Write the Q3 report
tasks.description: Summarise engineering output, incidents, and key metrics for the Q3 business review. Include team velocity charts and highlight blockers.

tasks.title: Set up error monitoring with Sentry
tasks.description: Integrate Sentry for frontend and backend error tracking. Configure alerts for P0/P1 errors and set up source map uploads in CI.

subtasks.title: Configure source map upload in CI

tasks.title: Implement OAuth2 login flow
tasks.description: Add OAuth2 authentication support for Google and GitHub providers. Must include token refresh logic and session handling.

tasks.title: Migrate database to PostgreSQL 16
tasks.description: Upgrade from PostgreSQL 14 to 16. Includes schema migration, query optimization review, and zero-downtime deployment plan.

tasks.title: Post-mortem: API outage on 2026-05-18
tasks.description: Document root cause, timeline, and action items following the 47-minute API outage caused by a misconfigured load balancer health check.

tasks.title: Fix memory leak in worker process
tasks.description: Worker process heap grows unbounded over 24h, eventually crashing. Profiling points to event listener accumulation in the task queue consumer.

subtasks.title: Remove stale event listeners on job completion

tasks.title: Update privacy policy for GDPR compliance
tasks.description: Legal flagged several clauses that need updating to comply with GDPR Article 13/14. Coordinate with legal team and update the public-facing policy page.

tasks.title: Migrate frontend to React 19
tasks.description: Upgrade from React 18 to React 19. Update concurrent rendering patterns, adopt new hooks where applicable, and resolve deprecated API usage.

tasks.title: Conduct user research interviews
tasks.description: Run 8 moderated interviews with power users to understand workflow pain points and feature gaps. Synthesise findings into a research report.

tasks.title: Add dark mode support
tasks.description: Implement system-preference-aware dark mode using CSS custom properties. Persist user preference in localStorage. Update all components to use semantic colour tokens.

tasks.title: Sprint Review & Retrospective
tasks.description: Bi-weekly sprint ceremony. Review completed stories, demo new features, and run retrospective for Sprint 22.

tasks.title: 1:1 with Engineering Manager
tasks.description: Weekly check-in to discuss blockers, career goals, and project status.

tasks.title: Q2 All-Hands Meeting
tasks.description: Company-wide all-hands for Q2 wrap-up. Leadership will present key results, product demos, and announce Q3 priorities.

tasks.title: Architecture Review: Notification Service
tasks.description: Review proposed architecture for the new notification service before implementation begins. Covers event queue design, delivery guarantees, and retry strategy.

tasks.title: User Interview — Enterprise Pilot Customer
tasks.description: 60-minute discovery call with the product team at Acme Corp to gather feedback on the enterprise dashboard and identify friction points.

tasks.title: Security Vulnerability Review
tasks.description: Monthly security review session. Go through latest dependency audit, open CVEs, and review penetration test findings from last cycle.

tasks.title: [FE] Master Data Validation
tasks.description:
SRS:

Popup-08: Master Data Review Required   ​
 * Purpose: display master data changes and allow user approval ​
 * Trigger: User clicks button View detail for a record with a status Review Master Data ​
 * Button behavior​
 * View detail: to expand detailed change section ​
 * Cancel: to close the popup and keep current status – Review Master Data​
 * Apply: to update master data. After then, the upload status is set to Success and set the version as Active version and show toast(1) '마스터 데이터 변경사항이 정상적으로 적용되었습니다. ​

Popup-09: Master Data Review (Expired)​
 * Purpose: to inform users that the Master Data Review request has expired because no approval action was performed within the configured expiration period. The system no longer allows the master data changes to be applied for this upload record ​
 * Trigger: User clicks button View detail for a record with a status Review Master Data Expired ​
 * Button behavior​
 * Confirm to close the popup ​

​SRS Link: [Outlook Dashboard prj_Screen Definition_VNB.pptx |https://lgcns.sharepoint.com/:p:/s/DADevTeam/IQBzmnsTHrH6RpiYo0kcBBLVAVYoxHIPBcQFgyezIj-iT3U?e=s65tqf&nav=eyJzSWQiOjY5NCwiY0lkIjoxMzU1NDg3MjV9]
